Index.title: Your First Connection in Korea
Index.subtitle: Navigate the maze of Korean mobile plans. No ARC yet? No Korean bank? We'll find the exact SIM or eSIM plan you can get today.
Index.catch22_desc: You need a Korean phone number to get a bank account. But you need a bank account (and ARC) to get a phone plan. Sound familiar?
Index.catch22_pay_desc: Crypto (USDC), Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal
Index.apps_desc: The essential apps you must download before landing.
Index.kakao_desc: The undisputed king of messaging in Korea. 99% of the population uses it. You cannot survive without it.
Index.naver_desc: Google Maps doesn't work well for walking or driving in Korea due to security laws. Get Naver Map.
Index.papago_desc: Better translation for Korean-English than Google Translate. Crucial for reading menus and signs.
Index.subway_desc: The most accurate subway navigation app. Covers Seoul, Busan, Daegu and more.
